page.title: Budgets
page.description: See how your spending compares with each category limit.

taskNote: Finish or cancel this {{month}} budget before changing months.

form.validation: Choose a category and enter a monthly limit.

states.chooseMonth: Choose a month to view its category budgets.
states.limitsError: We couldn’t load budget limits for {{month}}. Refresh limits to try again.
states.spendingError: We couldn’t load recorded spending. Used amounts and progress are unavailable.
states.empty: No budget limits for this month yet. Add a category budget to set one.

feedback.savedRefreshFailed: Budget limit saved. We couldn’t refresh the limits. Refresh limits before making another change.
feedback.deletedRefreshFailed: Budget limit deleted. We couldn’t refresh the limits. Refresh limits before making another change.
feedback.unconfirmed: We couldn’t confirm the change. Refresh limits and check the saved budgets before trying again.
feedback.refreshed: Budget limits refreshed. Check the saved limits before trying your change again.

card.zeroLimitNote: No percentage for a zero limit.
card.comparisonUnavailable: Exact comparison is unavailable. Check the amount before relying on this budget status.

explanation.reset: Limits start over on {{date}}. Each limit covers one calendar month.
explanation.zeroLimit: A zero limit is an intentional no-spend budget. It is different from having no budget for a category.
